title: When the Letters Wakes
author: Odile Almeida
blurb: Mara Oyelaran, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
